# Cottages on Mountain Creek

> > Residential mental health and addiction treatment center in Sandy Springs, Georgia, specializing in evidence-based care for young adults with conditions including bipolar disorder, major depression, OCD, borderline personality disorder, and co-occurring substance abuse.

Cottages on Mountain Creek is a Joint Commission-accredited treatment facility offering residential, PHP, and IOP programs with holistic therapeutic approaches. The center integrates fitness and nutrition support through partnerships like Carbon Performance to promote comprehensive wellness and independent living skills for recovery.

## Key Topics

- Mental health treatment
- Residential treatment programs
- Addiction recovery
- PHP and IOP programs
- Bipolar disorder
- Major depression
- OCD (Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder)
- Borderline personality disorder
- Schizoaffective disorder
- Young adult treatment
- Holistic therapy
- Sandy Springs, Georgia
- Joint Commission accreditation
- Independent living skills
- Wellness and nutrition support
